page.content:
Priasus and his brother Phokus were the sons of Kaeneus and were listed among the Argonauts in Hyginus' Fabulae. Other than the part mentioning the Argonauts assembling, the brother is not mentioned in Fabulae.

page.overview:
Who is Priasus?

Priasus and his brother Phokus were the sons of Kaeneus and were listed among the Argonauts in Hyginus' Fabulae. Other than the part mentioning the Argonauts assembling, the brother is not mentioned in Fabulae.

"Phocus and Priasus, son of Caeneus, from Magnesia."- Hyginus, Fabulae, 14 Category:Males Category:Heroes Category:Argonauts
